name: Hurstville Golf Club
why: OSM's 18 hole lines, tee points and pins match an older par 70, 5,447 m card hole for hole; Golf Australia lists par 69, 5,112 m after the council's staged redesign since 2021, and every hole was wrong in play on 2026-10-21. No current routing is published, so holes come from his GPS marks. The origin is unchanged: shots already logged are stored in this frame.
